name: pickup_respawn_queue_clear_and_free
description: PickupRespawnQueue::ClearAndFree walks the respawn queue, removes each linked entry from the queue, frees removed entries, and leaves the queue empty.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly at 0x41e270 returns immediately for an empty head, otherwise saves each entry's next pointer, removes the current entry from the queue head or predecessor link when count is nonzero, updates head, tail, unused, and count, calls the operator delete provider for removed entries, and advances to the saved next pointer.
Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x41e270 has no warnings or tags and shows the same queue unlinking, head/tail/count maintenance, conditional delete, and next-entry iteration.
The dependency frontier for 0x41e270 has no visible source blockers; the only direct callee is the accepted operator delete provider.
The native pickup_respawn_queue_clear_smoke builds a two-entry queue and verifies ClearAndFree clears unused, head, tail, and count.
